description: This file defines the StreamingQuery trait and RemoteStreamingQuery class for managing and interacting with streaming queries in Apache Spark, including methods for query control, status retrieval, and response parsing.

classes.name: StreamingQuery
classes.description: A trait extending Spark's StreamingQuery for connect API.

classes.name: RemoteStreamingQuery
classes.description: A class implementing StreamingQuery for remote management of streaming queries, including control and status methods.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the streaming query is active.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Waits for the query to terminate.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Waits for the query to terminate with a timeout.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the streaming query.

methods.name: recentProgress
methods.description: Gets recent progress updates of the query.

methods.name: explain
methods.description: Prints the explanation of the query plan.

methods.name: explain
methods.description: Prints extended explanation of the query plan.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Returns any exception occurred during the query.

methods.name: executeQueryCmd
methods.description: Executes a command on the query via the Spark session.
